bullets.text: Full-year CR 95.1 at 14% NPW growth, meeting the four-cent underwriting profit goal; Gainshare reached 1.67, the highest score since 2004; variable dividend declared at 68 cents per share.
Added $2.8B in premiums written following 2015's $20B milestone (+14% NPW); Direct sales grew 9% overall after high-teens first-half growth; Agency auto PIF +7%; Special Lines PIF +4%.

Achieved best year-end personal auto retention in company history; trailing 12-month PLE rose 5%; customers staying a decade or longer increased nearly 10%; Robinsons segment retention gains topped 10%.
Responded to 54 named weather events; CAT claim counts more than doubled 2015 and exceeded 2012's record by 28%; achieved 90% claim closure within 60 days for Louisiana floods and Hurricane Matthew.
Portfolio returned 4% on $23.5B, adding ~$515M after-tax comprehensive income; issued $500M 10-year senior notes at 2.45% coupon in Q3; debt-to-total capital ended at 28.3%, below the 30% guideline.
Agency auto PIF +7% across 35,000+ independent agents; Platinum program Robinsons PIF grew in +50% range; Direct auto PIF +9%; in-house Advantage Agency grew Robinsons sales nearly 100%.

Commercial auto experienced a mid-year accident frequency spike, prompting actions to slow growth and add rate in high-frequency segments; personal auto faced headwinds from rising loss costs and resulting rate increases.

Curtailed late-year advertising spend to secure stated 96 calendar-year CR goal; extended brand messaging from savings to protection with Flotection; launched 'Parentamorphosis' campaign targeting first-time homebuyers bundling auto and home.

Debuted mobile device UBI application in 2016 ahead of 2017 countrywide rollout; continuing significant enterprise R&D investments; enthusiastic about future commercial vehicle telematics to price small fleets.

Employee culture survey results improved in every category; hired over 6,600 people in advance of need across customer relationship and claims organizations; existing employee retention improved approximately 12%.
